# V1 — Core Build

**Status:** Feature-complete `2026-06-26`. All planned slices (19 numbered core slices + lettered slices A–K) committed on `main`. 303 JVM tests passing at completion; `assembleDebug` green. All pre-couples slices verified on emulator.

Bottom nav at V1 ship: **Records | Analysis | Budgets | Accounts | Categories** (Records = start/home).

Each slice is a full vertical: data → domain → sync → presentation, per the pattern in [project-build-progress.md](project-build-progress.md#per-feature-pattern).

## Lettered slices (A–K)

- **Slice A — Email confirmation deep link** `6fe8024` — `singleTask` launch mode + `com.iponlove.app://login-callback` intent-filter. `MainActivity` calls `handleDeeplinks(intent)` in `onCreate`/`onNewIntent`. Fixed missed `= null` defaults on `attachmentUrl` (test fixtures). Supabase dashboard: email confirm ON, redirect URL added. 245 tests pass.
  - Design lock: `handleDeeplinks()` runs regardless of lock state (auth callback, not a data-access path); lock screen shows after the callback is handled.
- **Slice B — Clock-offset calibration** (bundled in `edbcdf6`) — `get_server_time()` Postgres function. `SyncEngine` optional clock params + `calibrateClock()`. `SyncModule` live lambda. Offset restore in `IponApp.onCreate`.
- **Slice C — PIN / biometric app lock** (bundled in `edbcdf6`) — Full `feature/applock/` vertical. `AppLockRepositoryImpl` (SHA-256 + salt, DataStore). `AppLockManager` (`@Singleton`, `isLocked` StateFlow, 30s auto-lock). `LockScreen` (PIN dots + numpad + `BiometricPrompt` + Forgot PIN). `AppLockSetupScreen` (2-step entry + biometric toggle). `PersonalizeScreen` Security row. `androidx.biometric:1.1.0`.
  - Locked design: 4-digit PIN, SHA-256 + random salt in DataStore. Lock trigger: 30s grace period after backgrounding. Biometric optional on top of PIN, never a replacement. Forgot PIN = Supabase email/password re-auth to reset, no data wipe (standard PH fintech pattern).
- **Slice D — Budget alert notifications** (bundled in `edbcdf6`) — `CheckBudgetAlertsUseCase` (pure, 80%/100% thresholds). `BudgetAlertStore` (DataStore dedup keyed `"budgetId:month:threshold"`, cleared at month rollover — no new Room entity). `BudgetAlertNotifier` (channel + `NotificationCompat`). `BudgetAlertWorker` (`@HiltWorker`, personal + shared budgets — both partners notified independently post-sync). `POST_NOTIFICATIONS` permission. Chained from `SyncWorker` + enqueued from foreground sync. 12 new tests.
  - `edbcdf6` bundles B + C + D together: 271 tests pass.
- **Slice K — Room proper migrations** `54f9719` — `exportSchema = true`, KSP `room.schemaLocation`, `fallbackToDestructiveMigration` removed. `app/schemas/.../10.json` committed as baseline. Future bumps use `@AutoMigration` for new tables, manual `Migration` for structural changes. 271 tests pass.
- **Slice E — Note images** `f751f44` — Room v11 (`@AutoMigration(10→11)`). `supabase-storage-kt`. `PreSyncStep` interface + `SyncEngine` hook (runs before the push/pull loop). `NoteAttachmentEntity` (type/localPath/url/position, join table not a NoteEntity field — `type` future-proofs voice recordings). `NoteAttachmentDao`/`Dto`/`SupabaseNoteAttachmentRemoteSource`/`NoteAttachmentTableSyncer` (only dirty rows with `url IS NOT NULL`)/`PartnerNoteAttachmentTableSyncer`. `NoteAttachmentUploader` (`PreSyncStep`: compress → upload → stamp URL; max 1080px JPEG 85%). `AddNoteImageUseCase`/`DeleteNoteAttachmentUseCase`. `DeleteNoteUseCase` cascades soft-delete to attachments. Gallery picker + 80dp image strip in editor. `PurgePartnerReplicaUseCase` extended. 279 tests pass.
  - Storage: `filesDir/note_attachments/{id}.jpg` (never `cacheDir` — OS can purge it). Local file deleted after successful upload; Coil loads from `localPath` if `url == null`, else from `url`.
  - **Pre-ship dependency:** Supabase `note-images` storage bucket needed creating in the dashboard — done, see [project-build-progress.md](project-build-progress.md#infra-state).
- **Slice F — Note partner sharing** `17009ee` — Room v12 (`@AutoMigration(11→12)`). `isConflictCopy: Boolean` on `NoteEntity`/`Note`/`NoteDto` (`defaultValue="0"`); `PartnerNoteMapper` hardcodes `isConflictCopy = false`. `shareNote(id, coupleId)`/`unshareNote(id)` on `NoteRepository` (unshare retains `couple_id` per ADR-0005). `NoteTableSyncer` overrides `isSharedNote()`/`conflictCopy()` (forks local shared edits into a new `[Conflict Copy] ` note, `pendingSync=true` — ADR-0003, silent, no notification in V1). Heart icon toggle in editor top bar (paired users only); small heart badge on shared note cards. 283 tests pass.

## Grilled design decisions (2026-06-25, locked before build)

**Slice C (PIN / biometric lock):** PIN 4 digits, SHA-256 + random salt in DataStore. Lock trigger: 30s grace after backgrounding (coroutine delay in `LifecycleObserver`, cancelled on foreground return). Biometric optional on top of PIN. Forgot PIN: Supabase email/password re-auth resets PIN, no data wipe (standard PH fintech pattern — GCash/Maya). Deep link (`handleDeeplinks()`) runs regardless of lock state.

**Slice D (budget alerts):** Dedup via DataStore `Set<String>` keyed `"budgetId:month:threshold"`, cleared at month rollover, no new Room entity. Scope includes the shared couple budget; both partners notified independently post-sync.

**Slice K (Room migrations):** `@AutoMigration` for new-table additions, manual `Migration` for structural changes. Room 2.8.4 fully supports AutoMigration.

**Slice E (note images):** `NoteAttachmentEntity` is a join table, not a field on `NoteEntity`; `type` future-proofs voice recordings. Local storage in `filesDir`, never `cacheDir`. Compress → write locally → `pending_sync=true` → `NoteAttachmentUploader` (a `PreSyncStep`, since `BaseTableSyncer.push()` is `final`) uploads, stamps `url`, clears `localPath` — then normal push sends the row.

**Slice F (note partner sharing):** Conflict copy (ADR-0003) is silent — new note titled `"[Conflict Copy] ..."`, `is_conflict_copy=true`, no notification in V1.

**Slices G & H (analysis charts):** Custom Canvas composables, consistent with the existing `DonutChart` — no third-party chart library.

**Slice I:** Match `mockup.html`'s visual language (surface tokens, 14dp corner radius, chip styling, Sun-first calendar), not its outdated feature set.

**Slice J:** Bottom sheet fields = amount + category + account + INCOME/EXPENSE toggle, no date picker (always today). Calls `BalanceWidget().updateAll()` after save, same pattern as `MainActivity`.
